AWARD: 440000 DOLLARS
CONFIDENCE: 6
PRIMARY_RATIONALE: ECONOMIC_LOSS
SECONDARY_RATIONALE: PAIN_AND_SUFFERING
JUSTIFICATION: A documented 14 percent permanent partial impairment with grip-strength loss at age 46, supported by complete wage records and a functional-capacity assessment, establishes substantial lifetime earning-capacity loss on facts where liability is admitted and video-confirmed. The eleven-week treatment delay and attendance at fewer than half of prescribed sessions support a meaningful mitigation discount, since part of the residual deficit is plausibly attributable to non-compliance rather than the injury itself.
